title: Volcanoes of Europe (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Europe, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Lanzarote
rounds.fact: Lanzarote is a fissure vent; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1730. The data places it in Spain.

rounds.name: Terceira Island
rounds.fact: Terceira Island is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,022 m in the source data. The data places it in Portugal.
